name: reading-trail
title: Reading trail
description: Keep your place with a connected spine, an expandable bookmark or a descriptive chapter overview—all following actual reading progress.

props.name: items
props.description: IDs of sections in this document. Labels and links render on the server.

props.name: scrollRoot
props.description: Omit to track the document; pass a mounted scroll container for a panel.

props.name: offset
props.description: Activation line below the scroll viewport's top, in pixels.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Optional compositions; omission preserves the original document TOC.
